confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Mexican Pacific resort pricing, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; cocktail and wine are less certain and follow local price levels; hostel and hotel rates vary by season and property. The FX value is taken from a search-result summary of the RBA page, not from a direct read of the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Mexican Pacific resort towns and mid-sized Mexican tourist cities, using local peso price levels with a tourist-facing premium at ordinary venues. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer where direct knowledge is weak.
